name: Application
examples: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SMTP, DNS, SSH
desc: Network services for end-user applications. Closest to the user.

name: Presentation
desc: Translates, encrypts, compresses data between app and session.

name: Session
desc: Opens, manages, and tears down sessions between endpoints.

name: Transport
desc: Reliable (or best-effort) end-to-end delivery, segmentation, flow control.

name: Network
desc: Routing and logical addressing across networks.

name: Data Link
desc: Node-to-node frame delivery on the same physical medium.

name: Physical
desc: Raw bit transmission over the physical medium.
